issues.description: The problem statement refers to the state-preparation function as `_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)` (leading underscore) while both the template and the solution define the function as `construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)` (no leading underscore). This naming mismatch can confuse students about which symbol to implement and may cause tests or examples that reference the non-underscored name to appear inconsistent with the written instructions.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent across artifacts. Either change the problem statement to reference `construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)` (no leading underscore) or rename the function in the template and solution to `_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)`. Prefer updating the problem statement to match the template and solution (remove the leading underscore).
